registered_question: Can the complete four-arm synthetic comparative instrument, preserving the A4 scientific shape and exact-rational scalar/allocation plus deterministic block/encoding semantics, construct and atomically materialize its A4-reference-equivalent intermediate bundle within the frozen internal one-panel CPU cap while every produced decision is independently replayed and all excluded study work remains separately metered?

snapshot_sources.load_average: persist complete raw /proc/loadavg bytes and SHA-256; parse the first three decimal tokens
snapshot_sources.available_physical_memory_bytes: persist complete raw /proc/meminfo bytes and SHA-256; parse the unique MemAvailable kB field and multiply exactly by 1024
snapshot_sources.same_user_processes: one frozen ascending list of numeric /proc PID names followed by the exact two-stage effective-UID filter

prelaunch.snapshot_cross_invariants: loadavg_sha256 and meminfo_sha256 hash the bytes represented by their hex fields; available_physical_memory_bytes=memavailable_kib*1024; free_output_bytes=output_f_bavail*output_f_frsize
prelaunch.same_user_process_rule: persist every stably read same-effective-uid process from the frozen PID-name list, including zero-CPU-tick processes and the preflight process; bind its PID-filter record index and persist complete initial stat, initial/final cmdline, initial/final executable-link target, final stat, and final status bytes, with SHA-256 for stat/status/cmdline sources, plus parsed pid/start/state/CPU/comm fields
process_inventory_two_stage_rule: capture numeric /proc PID names once and sort by integer PID

for every captured PID read only initial /proc/[pid]/status, persist its raw bytes and SHA-256 in one pid_filter_record, and parse the effective UID; any missing or unparsable initial status makes the inventory incomplete
if effective UID differs from the preflight effective UID, perform no stat/cmdline/executable/final-status reads and emit no same-user process entry

if effective UID matches, read and persist initial stat, initial cmdline, initial executable-link target, final cmdline, final executable-link target, final stat, and final status in exactly that order

for a same-UID PID, any failed read/parse, initial/final cmdline or executable-target inequality, captured/filter/initial-stat/final-stat/final-status PID disagreement, initial/final-status effective-UID disagreement, or initial/final-stat starttime disagreement makes the inventory incomplete
emit every stable same-UID entry regardless of CPU ticks in ascending pid then starttime order, with its exact pid_filter_record_index
prelaunch.process_inventory_completeness_rule: only the six-step two-stage rule defines completeness; reading stat/cmdline/executable for a nonmatching UID, silently skipping an unreadable initial status, or filtering same-UID entries by CPU ticks is forbidden; a launched producer manifest requires process_inventory_complete=true
prelaunch.process_cross_invariants: numeric_pid_count equals pid_filter_records length and their PIDs are the strictly increasing frozen PID list; every filter-record status hash binds its raw bytes and same_as_preflight_effective_uid equals its parsed effective-UID comparison; same_user_process_count equals both the process-array length and the number of true filter records; each process points to its unique true filter record with the same PID; exactly one process has is_preflight_self=true and its pid/starttime equal the top-level preflight identity; each total CPU value equals user+system and may be zero; every stat/status/cmdline hash binds its raw bytes; initial/final cmdline and executable-target bytes are equal; parsed identities agree; final comm/state/utime/stime/total agree with recorded fields
prelaunch.proc_parse_rule: parse every raw /proc/[pid]/status unique Pid line as one ASCII decimal PID and unique Uid line as four ASCII decimal fields, using the second effective-uid field; parse initial and final raw /proc/[pid]/stat by documented Linux field numbers after taking comm as bytes inside the first opening parenthesis and the rightmost closing parenthesis before the state separator; fields 1, 3, 14, 15, and 22 are pid, state, utime, stime, and starttime; a missing/ambiguous parse, captured/filter/initial-stat/final-stat/final-status PID disagreement, initial/final-status effective-UID disagreement, or initial/final-stat starttime disagreement makes the inventory incomplete
prelaunch.cmdline_parse: decode each initial/final cmdline hex field to raw bytes and require equality; require zero bytes only as argument separators and, when nonempty, one terminal zero; split the final bytes at zero and drop exactly the terminal empty field; malformed cmdline makes the inventory incomplete
prelaunch.basename_rule: for the equal final executable-link target and each nonempty final argv byte field, take bytes strictly after the last 0x2f, or the whole field when no 0x2f occurs; perform no decoding, case fold, dot/dot-dot normalization, symlink resolution, substring, regex, or prefix match
prelaunch.marker_match_rule: matched_conflict_markers is the unique exact-byte intersection between those basenames and the frozen ASCII marker list, emitted in frozen marker order
prelaunch.future_process_identity_requirement: every A4-V2-I executable or direct script invocation capable of supervising, producing, verifying, or archiving must expose at least one frozen marker as its executable or argv basename; the prelaunch snapshot runs inside the outermost such process, whose parent and ancestors expose none; A4-V2-PAR must commit and independently review these exact invocation identities
prelaunch.process_allowlist: only the exact (preflight_pid,preflight_start_time_clock_ticks) entry is allowlisted; no parent, ancestor, sibling, executable, user, shell, or name allowlist exists
prelaunch.process_conflict_rule: a launched manifest contains only ALLOW_PREFLIGHT_SELF or ALLOW_NO_MARKER entries with conflicting_a4_or_saq_cost=false; the verifier recomputes every field from the byte preimages and top-level preflight identity
prelaunch.environment_binding: prelaunch_observation.environment_identity_sha256 equals the canonical embedded environment_identity hash
